name: Vittra
body:
VITTRA
CR 5

This beautiful woman in fine traditional garb decorated with gold thread regards you with a suspicious gleam in her eye.

XP 1,600
N Medium undead
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 57 (6d8+24)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +8
Defensive Abilities undead traits
Weaknesses resurrection vulnerability

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +4 (1d4 plus energy drain)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks energy drain (1 level, DC 17)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +10)

At will—alter self, charm person (DC 15), detect thoughts (DC 14)
1/day—blink, detect thoughts (DC 16), fear (DC 17), haste

Spells Known (CL 6th; concentration +10)

3rd (4 slots)—flashfire (DC 17)
2nd (6 slots)—acid arrow, invisibility
1st (7 slots)—cause fear (DC 15), chill touch (DC 15), speak with animals, snowball
0 (at will)—acid splash, detect magic, detect poison, mage hand, prestidigitation, stabilize, touch of fatigue (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con —, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 18
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Bluff +13, Disguise +13, Diplomacy +13, Handle Animal +13, Perception +10
Languages Common plus one other language

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Energy Drain Spells (Ex)

Whenever the vittra casts a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, the first creature that fails the saving throw is exposed to her energy drain. If multiple creatures fail simultaneously, the vittra chooses one of them to affect.

Resurrection Vulnerability (Su)

A raise dead or similar spell cast on a vittra destroys it (Will negates). Using the spell in this way does not require a material component.

Spells Vittror cast spells as 6th-level sorcerers. They treat druid spells as on their class list.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold hills, plains, and mountains
Organization herd (1-2 with 3-12 aurochs, elk, or other herd animals)
Treasure incidental

You may have seen a vittra before without even realizing it. Vittror appear as beautiful women who herd cattle or reindeer, often living quietly among humans for many years. If they and their herds remain undisturbed, that is all they seem to be. Should a vittra be angered or her herd endangered, she will reveal her true nature: a powerful wight with deadly magical spells.

Her soul is bound to defend the animals beyond death, sometimes to the point of paranoia. Her flocks often develop rare and valuable magical properties over long exposure to her magic.
